fields.v: All entries Claude Code (version n.s.) + claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, effort=low; k=1 run per task. Format: LinuxFL recall@10 / tokens; SWE-Pro resolved / tokens; SWT reproducing / tokens; SecBench resolved / tokens. No money reported. (1) Baseline (no MCP): 0.717 / 1.01M; 49.0% / 3.12M; 44.7% / 1.67M; 28.9% / 684K; wall 66-269 s. (2) AST: 0.757 / 755K; 50.6% / 2.45M; 45.3% / 1.77M; 25.3% / 656K; wall 105-209 s. (3) Callgraph: 0.770 / 683K; 46.2% / 2.31M; 37.9% / 1.69M; 34.3% / 614K; wall 105-201 s (best SecBench, worst SWT). (4) Deps: 0.757 / 628K; 49.4% / 2.41M; 42.9% / 1.77M; 31.9% / 651K; wall 88-205 s. (5) Docs: 0.770 / 663K; 44.3% / 2.53M; 47.2% / 1.82M; 31.3% / 698K; wall 106-290 s (slowest on SecBench, 290 s). (6) Hybrid: 0.829 / 611K; 50.6% / 2.59M; 47.8% / 1.87M; 29.5% / 658K; wall 82-204 s (best FL, zero FL losses). Relative to baseline, wall time rises with all workflows on LinuxFL, SWT, SecBench (SecBench 66 s vs 136-290 s) and falls on SWE-Pro (269 s vs 194-209 s). Verdicts: quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (all configurations)
